questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which part of a plant usually takes in water from the soil?
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and minerals from soil.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: What do green plants need for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants use light, water, and carbon dioxide to make food.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which feature helps a fish breathe underwater?
questions.explanation: Fish use gills to take oxygen from water.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A habitat is best described as a place where an organism ___.
questions.explanation: A habitat provides what a living thing needs to survive.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: In a food chain, what is usually the role of a green plant?
questions.explanation: Green plants make their own food, so they are producers.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which order shows a simple flowering plant life cycle?
options: seed → seedling → adult plant → flower and seeds
questions.correct_answer: seed → seedling → adult plant → flower and seeds
questions.explanation: A plant grows from seed to seedling, then adult plant that makes flowers/seeds.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which body system moves blood around the body?
questions.explanation: The circulatory system includes the heart and blood vessels.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why might an animal with thick fur struggle in a very hot habitat?
options: It may lose heat too slowly.
questions.correct_answer: It may lose heat too slowly.
questions.explanation: Thick fur helps keep heat in, which can be a problem in hot places.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Grass → rabbit → fox. What would most likely happen first if the grass became scarce?
options: There would be less food for rabbits.
questions.correct_answer: There would be less food for rabbits.
questions.explanation: Rabbits depend on grass for food in this chain.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which adaptation helps a bird fly?
questions.explanation: Wings and lighter bones help many birds fly.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why do many leaves have a broad, flat shape?
questions.explanation: Broad leaves expose more surface to light for photosynthesis.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which organs take oxygen from the air into the body?
questions.explanation: The lungs take oxygen into the blood.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: In a pond, algae are eaten by small insects, and small insects are eaten by fish. Which statement is best supported?
questions.explanation: Fish rely on insects, which rely on algae, so the link is indirect.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A wetland is drained and becomes dry soil. Which change is most likely?
options: Some water-loving organisms will leave or die.
Fish will have more places to swim.
Plants will no longer need roots.
questions.correct_answer: Some water-loving organisms will leave or die.
questions.explanation: Organisms adapted to wet conditions may not survive after drying.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which property makes glass useful for windows?
questions.explanation: Transparent materials let light pass through.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which state of matter keeps its own shape?
questions.explanation: A solid keeps its shape unless a force changes it.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which tool is best for separating sand from water?
questions.explanation: A filter can trap sand while water passes through.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why is rubber useful for rain boots?
options: It is a good food source.
questions.explanation: Rubber keeps water out and bends as feet move.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: What happens to water when it evaporates?
options: It changes from solid to liquid.
It changes from gas to solid.
It disappears as matter is destroyed.
It changes from liquid to gas.
questions.correct_answer: It changes from liquid to gas.
questions.explanation: Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapour.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which change is reversible?
options: baking cake batter in an oven.
questions.explanation: Melted chocolate can become solid again when cooled.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which change is usually irreversible?
questions.explanation: A cooked egg cannot be changed back into a raw egg.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which material is most suitable for an electrical wire core?
questions.explanation: Copper conducts electricity well.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: How could iron filings be separated from sand?
questions.explanation: Iron is magnetic, so a magnet can attract it.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why is metal often used for cooking pots?
questions.explanation: Metals transfer heat efficiently to the food.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A mixture contains salt, sand, and water. Which process helps recover salt after filtering out sand?
questions.explanation: Dissolved salt remains after water evaporates.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A material for a bike helmet should mainly be ___.
options: hard and able to absorb impact
questions.correct_answer: hard and able to absorb impact
questions.explanation: A helmet must protect the head by resisting and absorbing impacts.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which action is a pull?
questions.explanation: A pull moves something toward you.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Friction usually ___.
questions.explanation: Friction acts against motion between surfaces.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: What force pulls objects toward Earth?
questions.explanation: Gravity pulls objects toward Earth.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: If a toy car is pushed harder on the same surface, it will usually ___.
questions.explanation: A larger push can make the car accelerate more.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which unit is used to measure force?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which simple machine is used in a seesaw?
questions.explanation: A seesaw works as a lever around a pivot.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why are bicycle brake pads useful?
options: They remove gravity under these conditions.
They increase friction to slow the wheel.
questions.correct_answer: They increase friction to slow the wheel.
questions.explanation: More friction helps slow or stop the wheel.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why does a ball thrown upward come back down?
options: The ball runs out of colour.
questions.explanation: Gravity acts downward on the ball.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Two equal pushes act in opposite directions on a box. What happens if the forces are balanced?
options: The box becomes a magnet under these conditions.
The box must fly upward under these conditions.
The box doubles its mass under these conditions.
The box does not speed up in either direction.
questions.correct_answer: The box does not speed up in either direction.
questions.explanation: Balanced forces do not change motion.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which tool measures force directly?
questions.explanation: A force meter measures force in newtons.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A box is hard to move on a rough floor but easier on a smooth floor. Why?
options: The rough floor has more friction.
The smooth floor has more gravity.
The rough floor has no contact.
The box has less mass on rough floors.
questions.correct_answer: The rough floor has more friction.
questions.explanation: Rough surfaces usually create more friction.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A ramp helps move a heavy box into a truck because it ___.
options: spreads the lifting over a longer distance
turns the box into a liquid
stops all friction under these conditions.
questions.correct_answer: spreads the lifting over a longer distance
questions.explanation: A ramp reduces the force needed by increasing the distance moved.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which object is a light source?
questions.explanation: A lit torch produces its own light.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A shadow forms when an object ___.
questions.explanation: Opaque objects block light and make shadows.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Sound is made when objects ___.
questions.explanation: Vibrations produce sound waves.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: What is needed for a simple bulb circuit to light?
options: a broken path under these conditions.
a paper clip only under these conditions
a complete path with a cell and bulb
only a loose wire under these conditions
questions.correct_answer: a complete path with a cell and bulb
questions.explanation: Electric current needs a complete circuit.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which material is a good electrical conductor?
questions.explanation: Metals usually allow electric current to flow.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why is plastic used around many wires?
questions.explanation: Plastic helps stop current passing to people or other objects.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: In a torch, chemical energy in the battery changes mainly into ___.
questions.explanation: A torch produces light and some heat.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why can you see your face in a mirror?
options: Light reflects from the mirror to your eyes.
questions.correct_answer: Light reflects from the mirror to your eyes.
questions.explanation: Smooth mirrors reflect light clearly.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A tighter guitar string usually makes a ___.
questions.explanation: Changing string tension changes vibration and pitch.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: If one wire is disconnected in a simple circuit, the bulb will ___.
questions.explanation: A break stops the current flowing.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A screen is moved closer to an object while the torch stays in the same place. What often happens to the shadow on the screen?
questions.explanation: Changing distances affects shadow size; moving the screen closer often makes it smaller.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Two identical bulbs are in a simple series circuit. Adding a third identical bulb in series will usually make each bulb ___.
options: produce no heat but more light.
dimmer with a specific but incorrect qualifier.
questions.correct_answer: dimmer with a specific but incorrect qualifier.
questions.explanation: More bulbs in series share the energy, so each is usually dimmer.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Day and night happen because Earth ___.
options: moves closer to the Sun each day
questions.explanation: Earth rotates, so different parts face the Sun.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Soil is made from pieces of rock and ___.
questions.explanation: Soil includes mineral pieces and organic matter.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which instrument measures temperature?
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Seasons happen mainly because Earth is tilted as it ___.
questions.explanation: Earth’s tilt and orbit cause seasonal changes.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: What happens during condensation in the water cycle?
options: ice becomes rock under these conditions.
water vapour cools and forms liquid droplets
questions.correct_answer: water vapour cools and forms liquid droplets
questions.explanation: Condensation forms droplets from cooled water vapour.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which soil would usually let water drain fastest?
questions.explanation: Sandy soil has larger spaces for water to pass through.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A rain gauge is used to measure ___.
questions.explanation: Rain gauges collect and measure rainfall.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: After several sunny days, a shallow puddle disappears. Which process best explains this?
questions.explanation: Sun warms water, causing it to evaporate into water vapour.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: In a fair test, how many things should you change on purpose?
questions.explanation: A fair test changes one variable and keeps others the same.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: The thing you measure in an investigation is the ___.
questions.explanation: The measured outcome is the result or dependent variable.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which is an observation?
questions.explanation: An observation uses senses or measurements.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which tool is best for measuring the length of a leaf?
questions.explanation: A ruler measures length.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why are data tables useful?
questions.explanation: Tables make results easier to compare.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Which is evidence that ice melted?
options: The solid ice became liquid water.
The ice was in a story.
questions.correct_answer: The solid ice became liquid water.
questions.explanation: A change from solid ice to liquid water shows melting.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A plant near a window grew taller than a plant in a dark cupboard. What conclusion is best?
options: Light helped the plant grow better.
questions.correct_answer: Light helped the plant grow better.
questions.explanation: The evidence shows the plant with more light grew taller.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: To test which paper towel absorbs most water, what should stay the same?
questions.explanation: Keeping water amount the same makes the test fair.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: In a test of how ramp height affects toy car distance, what is changed on purpose?
questions.explanation: The changed variable is ramp height.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: Why should measurements be repeated in an investigation?
questions.explanation: Repeating helps check that results are consistent.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A table shows plant heights on days 1, 3, 5, and 7. What can it help you see?
questions.explanation: Heights on different days show a growth pattern.

questions.subject: science
questions.prompt: A student says, "The red ball rolls fastest." Which evidence best supports this?
options: The red ball looks brightest under these conditions.
The red ball travelled 2 metres in the shortest time in three trials.
The red ball was measured once without timing under these conditions.
The red ball is the student’s favourite under these conditions.
questions.correct_answer: The red ball travelled 2 metres in the shortest time in three trials.
questions.explanation: Repeated timed results are strong evidence for speed.
